chunks: (The angel) answered: 'Thus will it be. Your Lord said: This is easy for Me; for when I brought you into being you were nothing.'
ai.seo_question: What does God mean when He says 'This is easy for Me' in the context of creating prophets?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the divine attribute of *Yusr* (ease) and the absolute sovereignty of God's creative command (*Amr*), illustrating how He brings forth life from non-existence (*min al-ayn*) without prior material cause. It serves as a theological foundation for the miraculous nature of prophetic births, affirming that divine will transcends natural limitations, a concept deeply resonant with the Imams' teachings on God's omnipotence.
